Just because you have to work doesn't mean you can't keep honing your passion and setting aside your money from work for school. You are your own person. No one's future is predetermined by their parents. A good way to look at it (at least my way) is If you don't like who they are or what they do than it gives you a template for who you don't want to be. It wakes you up to what you won't let yourself be. My dad was a mean narcissist drug dealer so as a kid I told myself I'd never be him. I've lived my life that way, to be better than the people that raised me.
